text: LocalMultivarExecutor now resolves MultivarEstimator.Cpca per ROI: selected MatrixView is wrapped as a DualityDiagram, row constraints resolve against the sample space, column constraints resolve against the ROI-local observed/feature space, and Cpca.fit is called with the existing core algebra and storage policy. PlanSuite covers ROI-local column constraints and CpcaArtifact output. Verified with sbt "multivarJVM/testOnly scalafim.multivar.PlanSuite" and sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test".
